input.summary: Cap renewal price increases and add a renewal reminder
input.comment: [Playbook] The 12-month renewal term and 30-day non-renewal window work for us; we have added a cap on renewal price increases (lesser of CPI and 3%) and a 60-day renewal reminder so the opt-out is meaningful.

ops.oldText: unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
ops.newText: unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year. TrueLink shall notify Client of any upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term, and fees for any renewal term shall not increase by more than the lesser of the change in CPI over the preceding twelve (12) months and three percent (3%).

input.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Client and a reasonableness standard on consent
input.comment: [Playbook] We must be able to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, and consent to other assignments should not be unreasonably withheld; TrueLink should not assign to a Client competitor.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or, in the case of Client, to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity. TrueLink shall not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Client, and no change of control of Client shall give TrueLink any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
